conclusions: Ten scenario rows on the rendered page: 2, 4, 5 and 6 fail. A real pointer click on a marker opens the month's first day instead of the record (the strip's pointerdown handler rebuilds the track before the mark's click lands): ALT 2026-10-21 gave 2026-10-01, no record, no current marker. 27 markers against 59 records-list rows, and inside the two-year window every day of a month lands on one x, so different days print on top of each other. The gold 1961 birth label overlaps the 1970 label by 12 px, and January 2027 loses its label to the today label.
